title: docs(skills): objectstack-automation says a paused screen's Next / Submit and step count are engine-served
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-steve"} -->
_Requested by **Steve** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9?thread=cmsg_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9BRKZ9NNWRYqPQ1aXdmbQ7s)_

Fixes #26756

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**:`skills/objectstack-automation/SKILL.md` 的 `screen` 节点行加一句:「下一步 / 提交」按钮和「第 N 步,共 M 步」不是作者写的,是引擎在屏幕暂停时读流程图给出的 `progress`(`nextScreen` `none` / `possible` / `certain`,只有每条路径一致时才带 `step` / `stepCount`);屏幕后面接 `decision`、`fault` 边、回环、非屏幕暂停(`approval`、`wait`)或 `subflow` 一律答 `possible`(显示「下一步」、不计步);节点 `config` 里写 `progress` 会被拒,也不要把按钮文字或步数手写进 `fields`。
- **为什么改**:PR #26752 落地后运行时已经这样服务,但技能没教,按技能写向导的 agent 会手搓「提交」标签或「第 2 步」字段,或试图在屏幕节点上写 `progress`,没有任何门禁拦它。
- **风险与回滚**:只改已发布技能文本、token 上限行与一份 patch changeset,无 schema、键或行为变化;回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- **先看**:`skills/objectstack-automation/SKILL.md` 第 91 行的 `screen` 行(新增句),`scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs` 的 automation 行(6358 → 6466,算术在注释里),`.changeset/26756-automation-skill-screen-progress.md`。
- **两分钟验证**:`node scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs`,预期 `skills/objectstack-automation/SKILL.md is 6466 tokens (ceiling 6466; headroom 0)`。
- **需要你做的**:批准本 PR(`skills/**` 为 Tier H,需 GOVERNED_APPROVERS 的 APPROVED review;本 PR 保持 draft,席位不 ready / 不入队)。

## What changes

- **`skills/objectstack-automation/SKILL.md`, the `screen` node row** (the delta's "~L91" choice over L48: the node row is where an author declares `config.fields[]`, so it is where a hand-rolled label or counter would be written). One addition, in the row's own register: Next / Submit and "Step N of M" are not authored — when the screen pauses the engine reads the graph and serves `progress` (`nextScreen: 'none' | 'possible' | 'certain'`; `step` / `stepCount` only when every path agrees), which alone labels the button and draws the counter; a `decision`, `fault` edge, loop back, non-screen pause (`approval`, `wait`) or `subflow` after a screen answers `possible` — "Next", no count; `progress` in a node `config` is refused; never hand-roll a button label or step counter into `fields`. Every key and value is read off `origin/main`: `ScreenProgressSpec` in `packages/spec/src/contracts/automation-service.ts`, its wire shape `screenProgressSpecShape` in `packages/spec/src/api/automation-api.zod.ts`, the engine's `readScreenProgress` in `packages/services/service-automation/src/builtin/screen-nodes.ts` (plain reachability for `none`, fewest surely-pausing screens for `certain`, else `possible`; counts only when exact), the runner's reading in `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/FlowRunner.tsx` (`certain` / `possible` → Next, `none` → Submit, counter only with both `step` and `stepCount`), and `ScreenConfigSchema` in `packages/spec/src/automation/builtin-node-config.zod.ts` (a `strictObject`, so an authored `progress` is a named parse error, not a silent drop).
- **Paid under the standing ruling 「A:先削重复,余额按实测提高」** — fold restated wording first, then re-pin the ceiling at the measurement. Three restatements folded, each with its surviving home named:
  - Filter-operands bullet, "every other `{…}` token is refused, and" (-42 bytes) — Valid-but-silently-wrong item 1 lists "every CRUD `filter` operand" among the slots where a `{…}` token is refused. The trimmed bullet is re-wrapped (-2 bytes of indentation whitespace; the wrap bought nothing, the row's addition is paid by the cuts and the raise).
  - Trigger Configuration lead-in, "The binding is the START NODE — this is that node" → "This is the start node alone" (-23 bytes) — the Triggers intro already says the binding lives entirely in the flow's `start` node `config`, and the heading says "on the `start` node".
  - Valid-but-silently-wrong item 3, "; flow functions don't" (-22 bytes) — the item's own bold lead says a flow `function` does NOT read/write the database.
- **`scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs`**: the automation row moves 6358 → 6466, pinned AT the measurement, with the arithmetic in the row comment: 25429 → 25864 priced bytes (+524 added, -89 cut, +435 net) → ceil(25864 / 4) = 6466; headroom was 3 bytes (0 tokens), so the ceiling moves +108.
- **`.changeset/26756-automation-skill-screen-progress.md`**: `@objectstack/skills` patch (the catalog ships from `skills/**`), both declaration lines at line start.
- **No eval prompt.** `evals/flows-triggers-approvals.json` measures 2734 tokens against a 2734 ceiling (headroom 0), so a prompt fits only with a raise, which the card excludes; said here and in the report.

### Skills readings (whole file and whole package)

| Reading | Before (`origin/main` 8b276385) | After (270df422) |
|:--|--:|--:|
| `skills/objectstack-automation/SKILL.md` lines | 452 | 451 |
| `skills/objectstack-automation/SKILL.md` tokens (priced, stamp excluded) | 6358 | 6466 |
| All 11 `skills/*/SKILL.md` lines | 4606 | 4605 |
| All 11 `skills/*/SKILL.md` tokens (ceil bytes/4, stamp included) | 56135 | 56243 |

## Why

Once #26752 landed, a paused screen carries an engine-served `progress`, and the Console's FlowRunner labels the button Next or Submit and draws "Step N of M" from it. An agent authoring a wizard from the skill was told none of this: it could hand-roll a label or a counter into `fields`, or author `progress` on the screen node, and the skill did not say the runtime answers both from the graph. The docs half landed in #26752 (`content/docs/automation/flows.mdx`); this is the owed skill half.

## Tests

No test file changes: the diff is published skill text, a ratchet row and a changeset. `node scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs` and its `--self-test` pass on the head (readings under Verification).

## Acceptance notes

- The eval file's headroom 0 is why no eval prompt is added; a later card that raises that file's ceiling under the same ruling can add one asserting that an answer never spells a "Submit" / "Next" label or a step counter into `fields`.
- `origin/main` moved to 0f0b9f55 after this branch was cut; `dispatch-gates` reports none of the visible upstream commits touched what the gate list derives from, so `main` is not merged in (AGENTS.md §10: merge only on a reported conflict, a `main`-caused red or a queue removal).

## Verification

- **Build closure**: `bash scripts/pm/os-verify-lock.sh -c "pnpm exec turbo run build --concurrency=2 --filter='./packages/**'"` → `VERDICT command-exit 0`, 75/75 tasks, 8m43s under the lock (needed for the dist-reading gates below).
- **Derived gates**: `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` derived 63 commands from the 3-path change set; each ran serially with stdin closed and its exit code captured before any pipe; every one exited 0. Reconciliation: `dispatch-gates --ran` → "63 derived, 63 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN".

- [x] 2. Every name I added uses the casing for its kind. (No new identifiers; the keys named are the spec's own.)
